1.w: And it came to pass in the thereafter that He was traveling through each city and village preaching and proclaiming the good news of the kingdom of God, and the Twelve [were] with Him,

2.w: and certain women who had been healed from evil spirits and infirmities: Mary who is called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out,

3.w: and Joanna wife of Chuza, steward of Herod, and Susanna, and many others, who were ministering to them out of their means.

4.w: And a great crowd assembling and those [from] each town coming to Him, He spoke by a parable:

5.w: “The one sowing went out to sow his seed. And in his sowing, some indeed fell along the path, and it was trampled upon, and the birds of the sky devoured it.

6.w: And other fell upon the rock, and having sprung up, it withered because of [it] not having moisture.

7.w: And other fell in the midst of the thorns, and having sprung up with [it], the thorns choked it.

8.w: And other fell upon the good soil, and having sprung up, it produced fruit—a hundredfold.” Saying these things, He was calling out, “The one having ears to hear, let him hear.”

9.w: And His disciples were asking Him, “What may this parable be?”

10.w: And He said, “To you⁺ it has been given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God, but to the rest, [it is] in parables, so that, ‘Seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.’

11.w: And this is the parable: The seed is the word of God.

12.w: And the ones along the path are those having heard; then the devil comes and takes away the word from their heart, lest having believed, they should be saved.

13.w: And the ones upon the rock [are] those who, when they may hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, who believe for a time, and in time of testing they fall away.

14.w: And the [seed] having fallen into the thorns, these are those having heard, and, going along, are choked under the anxieties and riches and pleasures of life, and they do not mature.

15.w: And the [seed] in the good soil, these are those [who], in a beautiful and good heart, having heard the word, hold [it] fast and bear fruit in perseverance.

16.w: And no one, having lit a lamp, covers it with a vessel or puts [it] under a bed. But he puts [it] on a lampstand, so that those entering may see the light.

17.w: For nothing is hidden that will not become manifest, nor hidden away that shall not be known and come to visibility.

18.w: Therefore look how you⁺ hear; for whoever may have, to him [it] will be given; and whoever may not have, even what he thinks to have will be taken away from him.”

19.w: Now His mother and brothers came to Him, and they were not able to get to Him because of the crowd.

20.w: And it was reported to Him, “Your mother and Your brothers are standing outside, wanting to see You.”

21.w: But answering, He said to them, “My mother and My brothers are those who are hearing and doing the word of God.”

22.w: And it came to pass on one of the days also [that] He and His disciples entered into a boat, and He said to them, “Let us pass over to the other side of the lake.” And they set out.

23.w: And of their sailing, He fell asleep. And a storm of wind came down to the lake, and they were being swamped and were in danger.

24.w: And having come, they awoke Him, saying, “Master, Master, we are perishing!” And having arisen, He rebuked the wind and the raging of the water, and they ceased, and it became calm.

25.w: And He said to them, “Where is your⁺ faith?” And having feared, they marveled, saying to one another, “Who then is this, that He commands even the winds and the water, and they obey Him?”

26.w: And they sailed down to the region of the Gerasenes, which is opposite Galilee.

27.w: And [on] His having gone out upon the land, a certain man out of the city met [Him], having demons. And for a long time he was not wearing clothing and was not abiding in a house, but in the tombs.

28.w: And having seen Jesus, having cried out, he fell down before Him and said in a loud voice, “What [is it] to me and to You, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg You, do not torment me!”

29.w: For He commanded the unclean spirit to come out from the man. For many times it had seized him, and he was bound, being kept with chains and shackles. And breaking the bonds, he was driven by the demon into the wilderness.

30.w: And Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” And he said, “Legion,” because many demons were entered into him.

31.w: And they were imploring Him that He would not command them to go away into the Abyss.

32.w: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding on the mountain, and they implored Him that He would allow them to enter into them, and He allowed them.

33.w: And the demons, having gone out from the man, entered into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and was drowned.

34.w: And those feeding, having seen what had happened, fled and reported [it] to the city and to the fields.

35.w: And they went out to see what had happened, and they came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons went out sitting, clothed and sound-minded, at the feet of Jesus. And they were afraid.

36.w: And those having seen related to them how the one having been possessed by demons was saved.

37.w: And all the multitude of the surrounding region of the Gerasenes asked Him to go away from them, because they were seized with great fear. And He, having entered into the boat, turned back.

38.w: But the man from whom the demons had gone out was begging Him to be with Him. But He sent him away, saying,

39.w: “Return to your house and relate how much God did for you.” And he went away, proclaiming through the whole city how much Jesus did for him.

40.w: And on the return [of] Jesus, the crowd welcomed Him, for they were all looking for Him.

41.w: And behold, there was a man whose name [was] Jairus, and this [man] was a ruler of the synagogue. And having fallen at the feet of Jesus, he was imploring Him to enter into his house

42.w: because he had an only daughter, about twelve years [old], and she was dying. And in His going, the crowds were pressing around Him.

43.w: And a woman being with a flow of blood for twelve years, who, having spent all her living on physicians, was not able to be healed by [any],

44.w: having come behind, touched the fringe of His garment, and immediately her flow of blood stopped.

45.w: And Jesus said, “Who [is] the one having touched Me?” But all denying, Peter said, “Master, the crowds surround You and press in.”

46.w: But Jesus said, “Someone touched Me, for I knew power has gone out from Me.”

47.w: And the woman, having seen that she was not hidden, came trembling. And having fallen down before Him, she declared for what cause she touched Him before all the people, and how she was healed immediately.

48.w: And He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has saved you; go in peace.”

49.w: of Him still speaking, someone comes from the synagogue ruler, saying, “Your daughter has died; trouble the Teacher no longer.”

50.w: But Jesus, having heard, answered him, “Do not be afraid; only believe, and she will be saved.”

51.w: And having come into the house, He did not allow anyone to enter with Him except Peter and John and James, and the father and the mother of the child.

52.w: And all were weeping and mourning for her. But He said, “Do not weep; for she did not die, but sleeps.”

53.w: And they were laughing at Him, knowing that she died.

54.w: And He, having taken hold of her hand, called out, saying, “Child, arise!”

55.w: And her spirit returned, and she arose immediately; and He directed there be given to her to eat.

56.w: And her parents were amazed, but He instructed them to tell no one what had happened.
